objects.name: Update Now: Critical Zimbra Classic Web Client Flaw Could Expose Mailboxes
objects.description: Zimbra addressed a critical stored XSS vulnerability in its Classic Web Client that lets malicious emails execute code when opened. Zimbra has released version 10.1.19 to fix a critical stored XSS vulnerability in its Classic Web Client, which is widely used to access Zimbra Collaboration.
